name: dangxingyu/megakernel-zoo
title: Megakernel zoo: Claude-written single-kernel decode engines for 8 open models, up to 1.77x faster than vLLM and SGLang
summary: Agents wrote one GPU kernel per model that runs the whole decode loop, for eight open models from 8B to 594B, with a logit-match evaluator against an FP64 reference. Engines and an OpenAI-compatible server are open, and the pipeline can build one for your own checkpoint and GPU.
